name: Mangroves by longtail

seo.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour by Longtail | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Half a day by longtail in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove on Koh Lanta, with lunch, monkeys and birds, plus Old Town or a fishing park. From 1,000 THB.

h1: The Thung Yee Peng mangrove by longtail
lead: Half a day in the mangrove on the east side of Koh Lanta, by longtail through the narrow canals where monkeys and birds live, with lunch. Add Lanta Old Town and a viewpoint, or a fishing park.

facts.label: Where

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the drive to Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast of Koh Lanta.
With the local guide, a longtail around the mangrove forest.
Lunch, seasonal fruit and a soft drink at the mangrove restaurant.
End of the trip and transfer back to your hotel.

day.title: Mangrove, Old Town and viewpoint
day.note: Times with ≈ are approximate and move with the tide and the weather. The afternoon trip follows the same programme from 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the drive to Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast of Koh Lanta.
A longtail through the narrow canals of the mangrove. Watch for the monkeys and the birds.
Back at the pier, then the drive to Lanta Old Town.
Time to walk around Old Town, then lunch and a soft drink at a restaurant there.
End of the trip and transfer back to your hotel.

day.title: Mangrove and fishing park
day.note: Times with ≈ are approximate and move with the tide and the weather. The afternoon trip follows the same programme from 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the drive to Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast of Koh Lanta.
The mangrove by kayak or by longtail, as you chose when booking.
Lunch, seasonal fruit and a soft drink at the mangrove restaurant.
End of the trip and transfer back to your hotel.

beforeYouBook.children: Children from 4 to 11 have a child rate.

faq.a: The half day with lunch is the simplest. Pick Old Town and the viewpoint to see more of the island, or the fishing park if you are travelling with children.
Monkeys and birds live in the mangrove and the guide looks out for them along the canals. They are wild animals, so we cannot promise them.
The morning trip runs from 09:30 to 12:30 and the afternoon trip from 14:00 to 17:00, hotel transfer included. The programme is the same.

faq.q: Can we go in the rainy season?
faq.a: Yes. The mangrove trips run all year, while the national park islands such as Koh Rok close from mid-May.

faq.q: Is the village entrance fee included?
faq.a: No. Thung Yee Peng village charges 40 THB per adult and 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, paid on the spot.

legacyText.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Thung Yee Peng is a village on the east coast of Koh Lanta with a protected mangrove behind it. The channels are calm. You see monkeys, birds and fiddler crabs on the mud at low tide.

Three ways to go. A longtail runs through the main channels. A private wooden raft, poled slowly, leaves from Thung Yee Peng pier for a sunrise, a fishing morning or a dinner at sunset. A kayak gets you into the narrow channels.
legacyText.cardDescription: Through the mangroves by longtail, gondola or kayak.
goodToKnow: The raft is private, for your group only. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The kayak can be combined with an hour of ATV in the forest, two hours in all.
Bring mosquito repellent for sunrise and sunset.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. On the longtail and kayak trips the village entrance fee, 40 THB per person, is not included.
legacyText.caption: Thung Yee Peng
